scenarios.name: A teacher works through Teacher Training end to end — open, take a module check, pass, unlock the next
Teacher Training opens from any of its entry points
A teacher with no certificates yet is pointed back to training
A PDF module arrives as a document
Finishing every module unlocks the level exam, and passing it certifies the level
Asking for a certificate by its code sends the PDF
For a Beacon House programme the level exam is written answers, not multiple choice
For an Oxbridge programme a level is certified from module scores, with no exam
A locked level is selectable but the server refuses to open it
A module further down the list can't be opened before the earlier ones
Tapping the locked exam link explains what to finish first
Getting one question wrong fails the module check (NIETE needs 100%) and offers a retry
Asking for a certificate that isn't mine says it can't be found
A /certificate with a junk code just shows my certificates list
"/teacher training" (two words) is not a training command
Failing the level exam starts a wait before I can retry
An Urdu teacher gets the Urdu question text and Urdu options
/training works even in the middle of something else
Pausing a module check saves my place
A module retake serves a fresh set of questions
A half-finished module quiz picks up where I left off
A module's button is named after what tapping it does
A very long answer option is shown in full, not cut off
She sets how many of EACH kind of question, not one total we split for her
A count she cannot have is refused on the screen, naming the kind
Questions taken from the book never ask her to count by kind
